description: Confirm the baseline: Python tests green, dashboard JS parses, and the ESP-IDF receiver firmware still builds in this environment (needed for FEAT-002). No code changes.
steps: Run `make test` from /Users/christopherryan/Projects/Hackathon and record the pass/fail counts in findings.

Try the firmware build without flashing: `cd firmware/receiver && . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh && idf.py build` (ESP-IDF lives at ~/esp/esp-idf, tools in ~/.espressif; managed_components are already downloaded). Record whether it works and how long it takes. If it fails for environment reasons (network, sandbox), record the exact error; do not try to fix the toolchain beyond activating export.sh.
Do not POST to the running dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8050 and do not touch data/calibration/*.json.
acceptance_criteria: findings states the make test result, the node --check result and whether `idf.py build` for firmware/receiver succeeds in this environment
